verses.note: The proverb (இழுக்கத்தின் மிக்க இழிவில்லை, ஒழுக்கத்தின் மிக்க உயர்வு இல்லை) is applied to anyone who makes a learned speech (கட்டுரை) among கல்லாதவர், a type, not a person.
Item 2 (lingering at another's door by night) hints at adultery, but the verse states no gender rule, so norm is null.
அருந்ததிக் கற்பு praises the chaste wife but gives no rule of conduct, so norm is null; on a stricter reading it could be tagged gender.
The proverb is only line 4 (சொல்லாக்கால் சொல்லுவ தில்); line 3 is lightly corrupt (வெகுண்(டு)அரு கிற்பார்க்கும்).
There is no count word; the five குரவர் are listed by name in line 1. Honouring elders is not a purity or birth rule.
Fame is open to anyone, but the wife and the dug well are the householder's, so householder is given.
இந்நான்கு counts four, but இயக்கம் இரண்டும் covers two of them, so three phrases are listed; the verse has only three lines and may be incomplete.
The quoted proverb starts partway through line 3 (முடவன் பிடிப்பூணி யானையோ டாடல் உறவு). It is applied to the கல்லாதார் who provoke the learned, a type, not a person.
Under the brief's rule, புலை in a rule gives caste. The verse has three lines and may be incomplete.
